notes: State assertions read `../github-state.json`, the stub's state after the run; log assertions read `../gh-calls.jsonl`, one line per gh invocation. The harness copies both beside the workspace before grading.
`github-reached` and `state-only-through-gh` are guards: a run that never called gh, or edited the stub's files, grades as broken rather than as a skill difference.
A read-back passes when a successful GET of the changed resource, or any `gh ruleset` command, follows the last successful write.
Assertion commands run under /bin/sh, so they avoid bashisms.
